newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian pound steady against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian pound steady against dollar.

text.p: The Egyptian pound was steady against the dollar in the private-sector market on Wednesday but one banker said the short-term trend was for the pound to lose its recent gains as supplies of the U.S. currency increase.
The dollar ranged from 3.3950 to 3.3960 pounds bid and from 3.3960 to 3.3980 pounds offered in the interbank market, private-sector bankers said.
A survey of four actively trading banks gave average rates of 3.3953 pounds bid and 3.3970 pounds offered. These averages compare to 3.3951 pounds bid and 3.3971 offered on Tuesday.
The Central Bank calculated the average exchange rate at midday as 3.393985 buy and 3.398031 sell.
